worker_lifetime: one fresh isolated Python process per complete trajectory
resume: All committed output hashes rechecked. Partial resource-interrupted tasks archived, same manifest seed rerun. Numerical or identity failure stops; no outcome-based replacement.
root_lock: flock in parent; descriptor inherited by each worker, so an orphan worker retains the operation lease
fixed_numerical_sources: 24 retained files match original DV source manifest; horizon and simulator unchanged; worker metadata/phase guards/durability only changed
new_seed_derivation: Same SHA256-first8byte/modulo mapping recipe as DV, new study+rep labels. All 9500+1915 exclusions checked on host before allocation.
budget_at_start: Time limit covers launch loop, not initialization/hashing nor the completion of already active full trajectories.
on_limit_or_stop: Stop new launches, wait active trajectories, save progress and compact return ZIP.
outputs: New Linux study root only; Windows package results folder for reports. No public upload or network use.
future_stage: A separately supplied tool will learn all five states on committed development data before enabling the shared new tests.
source_chronology: Original v1.8 scientific protocol bytes unchanged; this operational realization follows the received readiness inventory and precedes new process generation.
